us-dealer-principals-gms-and-group-leade.headline: US Dealer Principals, GMs \u0026 Group Leaders - AI Dealership Ops
us-dealer-principals-gms-and-group-leade.body:
🚗 Calling US dealer principals, GMs and group leaders 🚗 \
\
I'm producing The Next Era in Automotive Retail: How AI is changing the American dealership - a Financial Times event in Chicago on Thursday 8 October 2026.\
\
This is a senior, peer-level conversation about what the dealership actually looks like once AI moves beyond bolt-ons and into the operating model. \
\
A few of the questions on the agenda:\
– When the buyer has already negotiated with AI, what does the dealer still offer?\
– Are current DMS and data structures fit for AI, or are they the bottleneck?\
– Where is AI delivering real margin in fixed ops — and where is the promise outstripping the proof?\
– When AI takes on the routine work, where do dealers redeploy their people?\
– Will the dealership of 2030 still have a BDC?\
\
I'm looking for speakers and panellists who:\
– Sit at C-suite, COO, CIO, CDO, GM or dealer-principal level in a US dealer group\
– Are actively deploying AI across sales, F\u0026I, service, BDC or inventory\
– Can speak candidly about results \
\
Self-nominations welcome. Recommendations even more so please tag or DM anyone whose story this audience needs to hear.\
\
Drop me a line: [email redacted]\
\
#AutomotiveRetail #Dealerships #AI #FutureOfTheCar
